status: approved by the user 2026-11-14; ids are layout v3's regions (regions.png)
style: Han-Viet first, romantic: classical images and allusions; each sect's regions share a theme. The last word says the land: Lam forest, Giac cape, Linh ridge, Hai sea, Xuyen river land, Son mountains, Mac desert, Chau land by water, Dao island, Nguyen plain, Loan bay.

1.note: The long lake under the northern moon

2.note: A cold cape with volcanic isles and hot springs

3.note: The hills whose haze names Thúy Vi Tông

4.note: Pine forest as wide as a sea

6.note: Dao Quang (Alkaid), a star of the Northern Dipper like Thiên Xu

7.note: Băng tâm tại ngọc hồ: the ice heart sits in the jade vessel

8.note: Vương Duy: đại mạc cô yên trực, a lone column of smoke over the great desert

10.gloss: Isle of the Lone Wild Duck
10.note: Vương Bột: lạc hà dữ cô vụ tề phi, the same line as Lạc Hà Tông

11.note: Vương Bột: thu thủy cộng trường thiên nhất sắc

12.note: The same line: autumn water one colour with the endless sky

13.gloss: River Land of the Fishermen's Songs
13.note: Vương Bột: ngư chu xướng vãn, fishing boats singing at dusk

14.gloss: Plain of the Heavenly Jade Wheel
14.note: Thiên Tuyền (Merak), the Dipper star beside Thiên Xu

15.note: Ngọc Hành (Alioth), a star of the Northern Dipper

16.note: The phoenix rests only in the wutong tree (ngô đồng)

17.note: Kinh Thi: the phoenix calls, the wutong grows facing the morning sun

18.gloss: Forest of Rain on Banana Leaves
18.note: Rain on banana leaves, a classic image of listening to rain

19.note: Kinh Trập: the solar term when spring thunder wakes sleeping creatures

20.note: Sơn Hải Kinh: the phoenix is born on Mount Đan Huyệt; here the caves are volcanic vents
